name: GD Medal AutoClip
description: Automatically requests Medal clips for Geometry Dash new bests and level completions.

public-key.name: Medal Public Key
public-key.description: Public key from the Medal Developer Portal. Required for event requests.

new-best-event-id.name: New Best Event ID
new-best-event-id.description: Event ID created in the Medal Developer Portal for new bests.

completion-event-id.name: Level Complete Event ID
completion-event-id.description: Event ID created in the Medal Developer Portal for level completions.

capture-delay.name: Capture Delay (milliseconds)
capture-delay.description: Wait after the event before Medal saves the clip. 15000 ms gives 15 seconds after the event.
